access_boundary: This record represents the MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL release announced September 22, 2026, a distinct efficiency tier of the MiMo-V2.6 line. The MiMo-V2.6-Pro sibling, the reviewed V2 and V2.5 records, and the Pro UltraSpeed serving mode are separate boundaries.
strengths: Fully open weights under a declared MIT grant with a technical report and RL harnesses
A distinct efficiency tier that outperforms the reviewed V2.5-Pro on agent benchmarks at a lower price
tradeoffs: A brand-new release with thin community runtime maturity
The 309-billion-parameter dense-MoE checkpoint is heavy to self-host
